conventions.zone_dependent: true = wiki states the container's loot changes by zone; null = not stated (the Containers page says only SOME containers do this, and names only red Lockers). Never false, because no page says a container is zone-independent.
conventions.breach: From each page's infobox 'Must Be Breached'. null = blank.
conventions.loot_types: Only the wiki infobox values that are loot-area names. Non-area values (Ammo, QuickUse, Weapon, Grenade, Blueprint, Material, Trinket) were moved into categories; the raw field is kept in wiki_loot_field. Empty = the infobox gives none.
conventions.categories_basis: 'stated' = the page names the category; 'derived_from_items' = inferred by us from the listed items.
conventions.confidence: confirmed = page states it and does not flag it unconfirmed; likely = page flags the data unconfirmed/WIP, or a single guide; unverified = placeholder/empty pool, so only name/breach/infobox fields are known.
conventions.metaforge_event_masks: MetaForge marker field eventConditionMask is a per-map bitmask; bit 0 = No Event. Decoded from MetaForge's map bundle: dam/blue-gate Cold Snap = bit 9, buried-city Cold Snap = bit 8, spaceport Cold Snap = bit 11; Hurricane = bit 12, Close Scrutiny = bit 14, Husk Graveyard = bit 4, Prospecting Probes = bit 1, Uncovered Caches = bit 3, Lush Blooms = bit 6, ARC Frigate = bit 16.

patch_changes.change: Security Lockers were over-providing valuable items and were adjusted.

Security Lockers now spawn dynamically across all maps instead of fixed placements. Also: more Great Mullein spawns, higher loot value in Epic key-card rooms, and blueprint spawns spread to more areas.
ARC Turbine parts no longer drop from Couriers.
ARC Turbines removed from standard sessions and most minor conditions; near-guaranteed in remaining conditions (Buried City, Riven Tides, Blue Gate, Spaceport).

Loot tiers by depth: Emperor containers near the entrance give lower-tier loot and higher tiers sit deeper inside; the Frigate also gets a higher chance of high-tier loot further in. Redirection pods: lower Emperor Key blueprint chance, plus a small chance of ARC parts. Some Storm Hut containers on Pendola Pass were moved. NOTE: no general Pendola Pass loot-tier change was found; the tier changes are for the Emperor and the Frigate.

marker_map.evidence: Legend 'Arc Husk' is a generic husk bucket, not a wiki container. Only 5 markers (Blue Gate, Riven Tides), named 'First Wave Husk', 'Deforester Husk', 'Arc Husk'. The wiki has a page for each husk type (Baron, Deforester, Rocketeer, Wasp) but no generic 'ARC Husk'. Treat it as an unknown husk type.

Legend 'Arc Probe' matches the wiki ARC Probe. Instance names include 'Downed/Crashed/Landed Probe', which fits the wiki's crashed-probe variant (one panel). Some markers carry the Prospecting Probes bit (bit 1) or the Electromagnetic Storm bit.

MetaForge's legend shows this key as 'Backpacks', and the most common instance names are 'Raider Backpack'/'Backpack'. That matches the wiki raider container Backpack. Some markers are labelled 'Suitcase' or 'Bag', and some lootAreas are zone names, so there is noise in community data.
top_instance_names: Epic bag against the broken tree trunk

marker_map.evidence: Legend 'Baron Husk' = wiki Baron Husk. 7 markers (Blue Gate, Dam, Spaceport).

Catch-all. The legend shows this key as just 'Container' (not 'Base Container'). It holds 13,280 markers with ~100 different instance names, mostly bulk-imported (they carry a sourceID): Transformer, Industrial Crate, Fuse Box, Server Rack, Wall Panel, Computer, Trash Bin, Tool Trolley, and so on. These are MetaForge's own prop names, not wiki container names. Only some match a wiki name 1:1. Use instance_name_breakdown to map single markers; everything else counts as a generic searchable container with unknown wiki identity. Confidence 'confirmed' applies to 'it is a catch-all', not to any single container.

marker_map.evidence: Legend 'Baskets'. The wiki has one basket container, Wicker Basket. Instance names say 'Winter Fruit Basket'/'Basket'/'Candleberry Basket'. The dominant event masks are 576/320/2112 = Lush Blooms + Cold Snap on the per-map bit layouts, which matches the wiki's 'appears with Lush Blooms or Cold Snap'.

Legend 'Boxes'. Only 8 markers, all on Blue Gate ('Gate Box', 'Pole Box', 'Raider Camp Box'); lootAreas say Industrial/Mechanical. No wiki container is named Box, and the evidence does not identify one.

Catch-all for breachables. Legend 'Breachable Container', 415 markers. Instance names are mixed: Electrical Transformer, Cooler, Data Server, Technology Container, Industrial Trailer, Storage Box, Wooden Crate, Metal Crate, Harvester Wall Container, Server Rack, Engine Hood, and others. Several match wiki containers with Must Be Breached = Yes (Metal Crate, Server Rack, Car Hood, Electrical Cabinet, Control Panel). 'confirmed' means it is a generic bucket; any single marker's wiki identity is unverified.

Legend 'Cars'. 941 of 994 markers are named 'Car Trunk' (bulk import), and lootAreas say 'Mechanical'. The wiki has no 'Car Trunk'. Its Car page says a car has a breachable Car Hood plus searchable seats, and Car Hood's loot type is Mechanical/Electrical. So a car marker most likely stands for Car Hood (plus seat loot). The trunk/hood naming gap remains.

Legend 'Combat Supplies'. 35 of 43 markers carry event bit 14 (mask 16384/16385) = Close Scrutiny on Dam, Blue Gate, Buried City and Spaceport, the four maps that have Close Scrutiny. The wiki has no 'Combat Supplies' page (the title is missing). Third-party guides (keengamer, arcintel) describe them as Close Scrutiny supply clusters of ammo, healing and grenade boxes. Model them as a Close Scrutiny-only raider-supply spot, not a wiki container.
Legend 'Deforester Husk' = wiki Deforester Husk. 4 markers, Blue Gate only (the wiki says there are 3 puzzle sites on Blue Gate).
Not in the current MetaForge legend; probably a legacy key. Only 1 marker (Spaceport, 'PC'), which might be Computer. Suggest folding it into base_container.

Legend 'Frozen Raider Cache'. 95 markers, Pendola Pass only. The wiki Raider Cache page says caches during Cold Snap lose their flora/sign and must be breached. A MetaForge guide says both frozen and normal caches exist on Pendola Pass, and that frozen ones open with the Raider Tool. So this is the frozen variant of Raider Cache (breach required). Its loot is assumed to match Raider Cache's 'higher quality during Cold Snap', but no source confirms that for Pendola.

Legend 'Hurricane Cache'. 382 of 404 markers carry event bit 12 (mask 4096/4097) = Hurricane. The wiki First Wave Cache page says First Wave Caches spawn during the Hurricane map modifier, and some community labels read 'First Wave Cache/Hurricane Cache'. Not 'confirmed' because the names differ and the wiki page is a stub.
Not in the current MetaForge legend; probably a legacy key. Only 1 marker (Spaceport, 'Drawers Tables'). Suggest folding it into base_container.

Legend 'Lockers', but it is partly a catch-all. Of 5,018 markers only 1,139 are named 'Locker'. The rest are drawer/cabinet props: Shipping Container Drawer 684, Medical Cabinet 627, Office Desk 600, Desk 378, Filing Cabinet 259, Medicine Drawer 253, Counter, Electrical Cabinet, Chest of Drawers, Medical Cart, Medical Workbench, Medical Locker, and 57 'Security Locker'. Map the 'Locker' instances to wiki Locker (red/green/blue; zone-dependent). The others are shown in instance_name_breakdown. Note that the 57 Security Locker instances conflict with security_breach.

Legend 'Med Crate'. Community instance names repeatedly say 'Med Bag'/'Medical Bag' (for example, many Stella Montis 'Med Bag' labels), and lootAreas are mostly 'Medical'/'Raider'. That matches the wiki's raider container Medical Bag. Pendola Pass has med_crate markers, and 2.3.0 mentions a Medical Bag in Pendola Storm Huts. It is NOT the medical drawers: MetaForge files those under 'locker' (Medicine Drawer, Medical Cabinet).
